## Details

### ems-machinedrum-firmware

Custom Machinedrum OS (independent track lengths/speeds, trig conditions, microtiming, 128 kits, many MDX-derived fixes), patched in the browser from your OS file. Patcher only, no source. Licence: unspecified; distribution: patch-your-own. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### fsdsp56k

F# toolchain for DSP56300 machines: prototype and render on an emulated DSP, pack as MDS packages for MDX X.20. Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### Gearmulator MD/MM

Plug-in and standalone emulation of Machinedrum and Monomachine (Gearmulator fork) booting your own OS file. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### Kitbasher

Browser tool adding extra sound models next to the stock machines of a Machinedrum OS you load (1.63, X.14, 26A09 beta, MDX X.20 B). Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### machinedrum-kit

RE docs for Machinedrum OS 1.63 with a Python toolkit, headless emulator and example DSP machines to build into your own image. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDMM (Machinedrum and Monomachine Editors)

Desktop editors for Machinedrum and Monomachine that run the unit's own OS in an emulator (app or VST3/AU), optional hardware MIDI mode. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDS (Machine Dump Standard)

Machine Dump Standard: spec, example DSP machines and Python packers for custom machines in the USR slots of MDX 2.0. Licence: unspecified; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDX

Extended Machinedrum OS (bigger sequencer, new machines, MIDI additions), shipped as ready-made SysEx. Binary only. Licence: unspecified; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### murdenihcam USR machines

Four user-machine families for MDX X.20 B: slicer, time stretcher, granulator, modulation effect. Licence: unspecified; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_
